methodology.schedule: paired teams, swapped directions, alternating challenger
methodology.bootstrap: 5000 paired team-pair resamples within opponent; seeds averaged on common schedule
methodology.seed_intervals: conditional on fitted policies; seed means reported separately
methodology.rng: Showdown and heuristic RNG not seedable
methodology.severe_regression: delta < -5pp and opponent paired CI upper < 0
